interface.name: pd_surface_host_manager_v1

description.summary: surfaces placed in another client's windows

interface.description: Core Animation lets one process draw a layer that another process shows in its own window: the drawing process names its layer by a context id (CAContext), the hosting process puts that id in its layer tree (CALayerHost). This is that across Wayland clients. A client exports a surface and gets a handle, any client imports the handle as a subsurface of its own surface. The subsurface object belongs to the importer, the surface's buffers and commits stay with the exporter.

request.name: import_subsurface

description.summary: make an exported surface a subsurface of one's own surface

request.description: The new wl_subsurface behaves as one from wl_subcompositor.get_subsurface, starting synchronized. A handle that names no surface, or one that already has a role, gets a subsurface that never shows anything.

interface.name: pd_surface_export_v1
interface.description: Sends its handle once, right after creation. Destroying it stops further imports, a surface already imported stays where it is.
